t: You're at the site of Arsenal Stadium in Highbury, which is now a defunct ground. It was home to Arsenal Football Club from September 1913 until May 2006, and everyone knew it simply as Highbury, after the district. It was designed by Archibald Leitch, a Scottish architect best known for designing football stadiums throughout Great Britain and Ireland. So this is one of many grounds that carry his mark, though the club has since moved on.
